text:
Priya: ACME asked for a per-region egress add-on. Bill by destination region, toggled per-route. They want a promotional ramp for pilot (approx 60% off for first 90 days) and then standard rates. If we do this they sign a 12mo commit.
Ava: clarify: do they want separate billing buckets per-region, or a single egress metric with region labels?
Priya: separate meter per region preferred. Also need per-customer hard cap + alerts.
Jai: finance: promos mean we need a promo flag on invoices and prorating for mid-cycle starts/stops. Also need clear reporting for committed vs usage.
Marco: infra view: we can add a header to mark destination region and wire it into request metadata. Mapping to billing metric egress.region.<id> is straightforward. Estimate: infra work 2.5w, billing integration 1w, console UX 4d.
Sam: timeline ask from sales: pilot must be available by target date May 15 for their onboarding. They want org-level promo by default across routes.
Ava: engineering note: Hosted routing vs Dedicated pinned pools — we need fallback behavior when a region is unavailable. Should we auto-failover to nearest region and bill as that region or bill to fallback bucket?
Priya: for launch propose: single-region-per-request only. If fallback occurs we'll bill to unified egress bucket and surface a warning. No multi-region fan-out for V1.
Jai: legal/finance: need contractual language for the promo window, credit terms if we miss ship date, and explicit definitions of "region" for billing.
ops-bot: audit log required: creation/changes of per-route egress tags and promo toggles must be recorded.
Marco: quick API sketch (example):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\n  -H "X-Dest-Region: eu-west-1" \\n  -H "X-Route-Tag: payments" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-4x","prompt":"..."}'
```
Billing picks X-Dest-Region -> emits metric egress.region.eu-west-1.
Ava: QA question: do we allow multiple region headers (fan-out)? That would multiply billing complexity and require per-subrequest attribution. Not for launch.
Priya: agreed. V1 = single region. Fan-out accepted as feature request for V2.
Sam: sales asks: if we can't deliver org-level promo immediately, can finance do a manual overlay (one-off credits) for the pilot?
Jai: finance can support manual credits for pilot customers, but building an overlay discount system is separate work (estimate 2w). Recommend manual credits + tracked ticket.
Priya: decision needed: greenlight scoped V1 (single-region-per-request, per-region meters, promo window support via billing flag, manual overlay credits handled offline) OR delay until overlay discounts built.
Ava: recommend scoped V1 to hit pilot timeline. Limits cross-team scope and reduces risk.
Marco: concur. We deliver core metering and promo toggle. Overlay discount to roadmap for post-pilot.
Sam: I'll negotiate contract clause: we will provide overlay discount system within 90 days or provide prorated credits. Sales can accept that.
Jai: finance OK with pilot credits; please get clear SLO for implementation time in contract.
Priya: proposed launch checklist: 1) API header supported + SDK examples, 2) billing metric egress.region.* emitted and exported to reporting, 3) promo window flag (start,end,rate) applied at invoice time, 4) console toggle for routes + alerting for caps, 5) audit logs enabled, 6) docs + eval tests, 7) migration plan for existing customers.
Ava: I'll draft the API/SDK change doc and console mockups.
Marco: I'll post infra task breakdown & RFC with timelines.
Jai: I'll update billing schema and stub promo toggle; coordinate proration rules with legal.
Sam: I'll push contract language to legal and confirm pilot acceptance criteria with ACME.
ops-bot: action items recorded.
Priya: ok thanks. Tagging this for roadmap sync and next weekly priorities. :rocket:
